title: Delete order is a tiny red x with no label
whatIDid: Saved a new order and landed on the order page on my phone.
expected: A clearly labelled Delete button, big enough to tap on purpose and far enough away that I do not hit it by accident.
actual: There is a tiny red x square (maybe 10 px) right under the customer name with no text. I only guessed it deletes the order. On a phone that is both hard to hit and easy to hit by mistake.

title: Delivery date shows as computer code
whatIDid: Entered delivery date 20/11/2026 on the new order form and saved.
expected: The order page shows the date like I entered it, e.g. 20/11/2026 or 20 nov 2026.
actual: It shows 2026-11-20T00:00:00.000Z. Looks like computer code, and I worry about time zones - is it really the 20th?

title: Delivery date shows strange letters and zeros
whatIDid: I made a new order and put the delivery date 28/11/2026, then pressed Save order.
expected: To see my date written normally, like 28 November 2026.
actual: The order page says 2026-11-28T00:00:00.000Z. There is a T and a Z and many zeros. It looks like a computer code, not a date. I am not sure it is the right day.

title: Delivery date shows as a computer timestamp
whatIDid: Added a new order with delivery date 20/11/2026 and saved it.
expected: The order page to show the date the way I typed it, like 20/11/2026 or 20 November 2026.
actual: The order page shows Delivery: 2026-11-20T00:00:00.000Z. It looks like code, and I had to squint to be sure it was the right day.

note: Same thing for me: typed 20/11/2026, order page shows 2026-11-20T00:00:00.000Z. My F-4 is a duplicate of this one, sorry.

title: Uploaded photo never shows up - cannot tell if it saved
whatIDid: On my new order I tapped Choose File in Photo of the goods and picked goods.png. Then I reloaded the order page.
expected: See the photo (or at least a thumbnail / file name) on the order so I know it is attached.
actual: A message flashed Photo uploaded (0 KB) and disappeared. 0 KB made me nervous. No picture appears anywhere, and after reload the box just says No file chosen. I have no idea if the photo is on the order.

title: Map will not let me choose the delivery spot
whatIDid: Under Mark the delivery spot I tapped the red dot (Spot marked flashed), then tapped another place on the map where I wanted it.
expected: Tap anywhere to put the delivery spot where my customer is, and then see the marker stay there.
actual: The red dot is already placed before I do anything and tapping elsewhere says That is not the delivery spot. So I cannot choose it at all. The map is just grey stripes, no streets, and nothing on it changes after Spot marked - after a reload I cannot tell if anything was saved.

title: Tiny red x on the order page with no label
whatIDid: Opened my new order and pressed Tab past the top menu.
expected: Focus to go to something I can understand, like the photo upload, or a button that says what it does.
actual: Focus lands on a very small red x just under the customer name. It has no words, the focus outline around it is tiny and hard to see, and I cannot tell if it deletes the order or closes something, so I did not dare press it.

title: Clicked the red circle on the map but nothing changes
whatIDid: On my order page I clicked the red circle on the map, like it says.
expected: To see that the spot is marked, a pin or a tick or the circle changing, and it staying there.
actual: A small word flashed and went away before I could read it. The map looks exactly the same as before. There is no save button. I do not know if the delivery spot is marked or not. Also the map is only grey lines, I cannot see roads or where my customer lives.

title: My one new order shows up two times in the list
whatIDid: I filled in the new order for Esi Darkwa and pressed Save order (I click twice quick, like I always do with the mouse).
actual: The list now has Esi Darkwa two times, both 6 items, both 28 November. I only made one order. It did not warn me. Now I am afraid I will make 12 pots or deliver twice.

title: Cannot mark the delivery spot without a mouse
whatIDid: On my new order, I pressed Tab from the photo upload to get to the map and the red circle. I also scrolled to the bottom of the page with Space to look for another way.
expected: To reach the map or the red circle with Tab and pick the spot with Enter, Space or the arrow keys, or at least a text box or button to set the spot.
actual: Tab jumps straight from the photo upload back to the top menu. The map and the red circle never get focus, and there is nothing under the map. The page just says Click the red circle, which I cannot do. I cannot finish this step at all.

title: Dark mode does nothing and forgets itself
whatIDid: In Settings I ticked Dark mode (tapped the words), waited, then reloaded the page.
expected: The app turns dark right away, and stays dark next time. Or a Save button if it needs one.
actual: The box got ticked but the page stayed light. There is no Save button. After reload the box is unticked again, so the setting is just lost.

title: My photo of the pots never shows on the order
whatIDid: On the order page I pressed Choose File and picked my picture goods.png. A message came for a second. Then I went to the list and opened the order again.
expected: To see my picture of the pots on the order.
actual: No picture anywhere. Only a small red x near the top under the name. When I come back it says No file chosen. I do not know if my photo is saved or lost. The quick message said 0 KB, that sounds like nothing.

title: Same order shows up twice in the list
whatIDid: Opened the Orders list and scrolled through it.
actual: Esi Darkwa, 6 items, 2026-11-28 is listed twice, identical. Looks like the order got saved twice (double tap on Save?). Nothing warns about it, and I could easily deliver twice.

title: Choose File button does nothing when I come back to the order
whatIDid: I came back to Esi Darkwa order from the list and pressed Choose File to put my photo in again. I tried two times.
expected: The box with my pictures to open, like the first time.
actual: Nothing opened. No box, no message. The button just sits there. The first time it worked, now it does not. I gave up on the photo.

title: No way to edit an order once saved
whatIDid: Opened my saved order to fix things (the date shows weird, and customers change quantities all the time).
expected: An Edit button to change quantity, delivery date or notes.
actual: There is no Edit anywhere on the order page. The only action is the tiny red x that deletes it. So to fix a typo I would have to delete and type the whole order again.

title: No way to take away the extra order or change an order
whatIDid: I wanted to remove the second Esi Darkwa order and fix things. I looked on her order page, top to bottom, and in Settings.
expected: A Delete or Change button somewhere on the order.
actual: There is no button to change or remove an order. Settings only has Language and Dark mode. The wrong extra order just stays in my list and I cannot fix it.

title: Uploaded photo is nowhere to be seen on the order
whatIDid: On my new order I chose goods.png in the photo upload. A message said Photo uploaded (0 KB). Then I found the order again through search and opened it.
expected: To see the photo of the goods on the order, or at least its file name, so I know it is attached.
actual: The order page shows only the upload box with No file chosen. No picture, no file name. Together with the 0 KB message I have no idea if the photo was really saved.

title: List says 1 items
actual: Mia Chen shows 1 items. Small, but looks sloppy to customers if they ever see my screen.

note: Same for me with goods.png: message said Photo uploaded (0 KB), but reopening the order shows only No file chosen and no picture. My F-17 is a duplicate of this.

title: List says 1 items
whatIDid: Looked at the orders list after signing in.
expected: 1 item for an order with a single item.
actual: Mia Chen shows as 1 items. Small thing, but it looks sloppy to me.
